prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. One finished landscape 3:2 full-bleed picture-book illustration, one coherent scene and moment, no panels or contact sheet. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
 No named child cast: Kit and Zoe MUST NOT appear. Include unnamed human workers/adults ONLY when explicitly required by this particular scene; otherwise show only the natural subjects. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: Boot Prints on the Moon; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: Scientifically grounded comparison of the sunlit gray Moon surface with a separate Earth garden path. One unnamed astronaut in a plain white pressure suit with gold visor, rectangular life-support pack and ribbed boot soles; no logos, flags or exposed skin.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): Gray loose lunar dust with ribbed boot prints; One plain white astronaut suit; One Earth brown-mud boot print for contrast
 Input references lock identity, prop design and location; compose a NEW image for the exact scene, never reproduce the reference-board layout. The reference and overall prop list may contain finished objects and later story events: these are DESIGN REFERENCES ONLY, not permission to show them now. Show only the people, objects and development stage required below.
Page 4. Printed prose (NOT text to put in art): On Earth, rain can wash prints away.
Required illustration: Scientifically grounded comparison of the sunlit gray Moon surface with a separate Earth garden path. One unnamed astronaut in a plain white pressure suit with gold visor, rectangular life-support pack and ribbed boot soles; no logos, flags or exposed skin. Separate Earth scene: rain falls on a brown muddy garden-path footprint and small rivulets soften its edges. Exact state: Clearly Earth with plants and gray sky; not rain on Moon.
Exact current state: Clearly Earth with plants and gray sky; not rain on Moon.
Do not add later events, duplicate props or a separate inset. No written title; the app renders live text.
SCENE LOCK: This page is ONLY an Earth brown garden path with rain, plants and gray sky. NO astronaut, no Moon, no split comparison. Match the boot tread with simple transverse ribs. No numbers, arrows or labels. Entire scene bold crisp clean flat 2D outlines, sparse outlined stones on flat gray soil, no granular photographic dust texture, stippling, paint or grain.

visualReview.note: Separate Earth scene has plants, rain, brown mud and rivulets softening print; no lunar setting mixed in.
